_about: Performance budgets (milliseconds, the median of midgard_bench's runs), checked by tools/budgets.py. A benchmark fails when it takes longer than its budget plus the margin. 'default' applies everywhere unless a platform has its own value; CI's platforms are named ci-<preset>, and its Linux jobs render with software Vulkan (lavapipe). Budgets are about 2-3 times the slowest CI timing seen (CI runs 38842790692 and, for the job system with a queue per worker, 38845093430; 15 October 2026; texture transcoding: 38924696676, 16 October 2026), so a real slowdown fails but runner noise doesn't. Every benchmark needs a budget.

physics.step_500_boxes._about: 1.3 ms at most in CI run 38941558221 (Windows and Linux).

render.cubes_400_offscreen._about: Lavapipe draws on the CPU: about 9 ms with materials and textures (CI run 38920735884), then 26 ms once the frame drew four 2048 x 2048 shadow maps too (run 38929597644), so its budget is 60.

render.cubes_400_phone._about: The phone tier on lavapipe (CPU): 12.2 ms on linux-release and 13.7 ms on linux-arm64 (CI run 38935998601), so its budget is 30.
